newsitem.title: USA: Police dog "runs down" suspect in U.S. squad car.
newsitem.headline: Police dog "runs down" suspect in U.S. squad car.

text.p: A police car with a dog at the wheel knocked down a suspected bus hijacker in San Diego on Friday at the end of a high-speed chase through the city, CBS radio reported on Saturday.
The drama unfolded under the gaze of hundreds of gawping onlookers as the hijacked bus was finally stopped after 2-1/2 hours by police using spiked strips to puncture its tires.
As the man who allegedly hijacked the bus with a knife stepped off it and gave himself up a police car rolled into him, knocking him over, CBS reported.
Apparently the squad car driver failed to apply the handbrake when he got out and the police dog leaped into the driver's seat as the car began to roll forward.
The radio station said police reported the suspect, who had ejected the bus driver and a sole passenger, was unhurt.
